Configure liter-llm to extract text with a vision-capable model

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, LlmConfig, OcrConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="image/png", uri="https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png")
    config = ExtractionConfig(force_ocr=True, ocr=OcrConfig(backend="vlm", enabled=True, language=["eng"], vlm_config=LlmConfig(model="openai/gpt-4o-mini", temperature=0.0)))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
